C1.key_claim_TRUE: Programmable CRISPR-Cas9 DNA cleavage uses a guide RNA and requires a PAM; demonstrated by Doudna & Charpentier, published in Science 2012; 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
C1.nuance: co-first authors of the 2012 paper were Jinek & Chylinski; Doudna/Charpentier senior authors
C1.false_key_claim: CRISPR-Cas9 was invented by a fabricated researcher in 2016 and cuts DNA guided by a protein zinc-finger domain, not RNA, with no PAM.

C2.key_claim_TRUE: Industrial trans fats raise LDL and lower HDL, increasing CHD risk; WHO REPLACE (2018); US FDA removed PHO GRAS status (2015, compliance 2018/2020).
C2.false_key_claim: Industrial trans fats have no significant effect on cholesterol or heart disease, and WHO withdrew REPLACE in 2022.

C3.key_claim_TRUE: JWST launched 25 Dec 2021; ~6.5 m segmented gold-coated mirror; infrared; Sun-Earth L2; instruments NIRCam, NIRSpec, MIRI, FGS/NIRISS.
C3.false_key_claim: JWST is a 2.4 m ultraviolet-optical telescope launched in 2019 into low Earth orbit; main instrument WUVS.

C4.key_claim_TRUE: HTTP/3 (RFC 9114) runs over QUIC (UDP-based, RFC 9000); avoids TCP head-of-line blocking; built-in TLS 1.3; faster (0-RTT on resumption) setup vs HTTP/2.
C4.nuance: 0-RTT applies to session resumption, with a replay caveat
C4.false_key_claim: HTTP/3 runs over TCP Fast Open (not UDP); QUIC was deprecated in 2021; HTTP/3 removes mandatory encryption.

C5.key_claim_TRUE: GLP-1 receptor agonists mimic incretin GLP-1: glucose-dependent insulin secretion, glucagon suppression, slowed gastric emptying, reduced appetite; approved for T2D; semaglutide also for chronic weight management.
C5.false_key_claim: Semaglutide works by irreversibly blocking intestinal fat absorption (lipase inhibition) and is approved primarily as a cure for type 1 diabetes.

C6.key_claim_TRUE: Montreal Protocol (1987) phases out ozone-depleting substances (CFCs, halons); ozone layer recovering, projected ~mid-21st century; Kigali Amendment (2016) phases down HFCs.
C6.nuance: HFCs don't deplete ozone (greenhouse gases); Kigali is a climate measure appended to the ozone treaty
C6.false_key_claim: The Montreal Protocol (1997) mainly caps CO2 emissions; the ozone layer has kept thinning with no recovery.
